prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single draggable loose newspaper scrap sprite for Ratlantis, a hand-illustrated navy and muted gold nighttime adventure game. Primary request: one wide, small rectangular scrap of old cream newsprint viewed directly from above, flat enough to sit over an open newspaper, with a believable slightly curled lower-right corner, soft crinkles, a diagonal fold, irregular torn fibrous edges, and a restrained thin contact shadow. Composition: isolated horizontally oriented scrap, approximately 2.6 times wider than tall, completely visible with a small transparent margin on all sides. Entire background must be genuinely transparent. Style: quietly hand-painted aged paper, tactile subtle ink-and-wash texture, muted cream/beige, subtle brown edges, no metallic fixtures or leather. The reverse side of a discarded newspaper: faint ghost impressions of tiny printed columns may show through, but absolutely no legible letters, no words, no headlines, no numbers, no diagrams, no charts. The scrap should feel naturally loose and slightly crumpled, not a UI button, plaque or ornate scroll. Avoid heavy burn marks, exaggerated holes, bright yellow, busy details. Generate just the one piece of paper, no other objects.
